biggest_catch: Your friend must complete 10 debit card purchases or $500+ in direct deposits within 60 days - otherwise you get nothing.
catches: Referrer: TBK Bank customer who registers for the referral program and shares the offer.
Referrer earns a $50 Mastercard Reward Card per individual or business referred; 'A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Reward Cards (for a total up to $500 value) within a calendar year.'

Friend must: register, open a new eligible account (AIM, Everyday, or Launch Personal Checking; or Business Interest, Business, or Business Basic Business Checking), and within 60 days complete 10 debit card purchases (excl. ATM) OR $500+ in qualifying direct deposits.
Only one referrer may receive a Reward Card per referred person; the first referrer that enters information for a referred person is the eligible one.
Converted accounts are not eligible; all account applications subject to TBK Bank approval.
Reward Card mailed 4-6 weeks after requirements are met; cards subject to terms delivered with the card; may be reported as income to the IRS.
Offer effective 11/13/2024, subject to change at any time; not valid with any other product offers.
Distinct from R5978, which is TBK's Launch Checking up-to-$50 account bonus - this route is the referrer-side earning mechanism.

steps: Register for the TBK Bank referral program and share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers.
Friend registers, opens a new eligible TBK checking account, and completes 10 debit purchases or $500+ in direct deposits within 60 days.
You receive a $50 Mastercard Reward Card per qualifying referral - up to ten ($500) per calendar year.
timing: Reward Card mailed 4-6 weeks after all offer requirements are met.
when_cash_arrives: Reward Card mailed 4-6 weeks after all offer requirements are met. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
